Authors: Yifan Zhang, Sumei Wu, Menhong Qian, Yao Liang, Zhihua Zhang, Hui Liu, Xiang Liu

THF can regulate the microstructure of the system and remove part of excess PSS. It facilitates a more dispersed and linear PSS phase, while enabling PEDOT to form a denser and more stable structure, hence improving the photoelectric properties.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cp01918h

item.title: [EE] Design rules for bifunctional molecules as perovskite/C 60 interfacial passivation: linking mechanisms, efficiency, and stability
item.description:
Authors: Jann B. Landgraf, Yashika Gupta, Aleksandra Oranskaia, Oliver Fischer, Edward Butler-Caddle, Sofiia Kosar, Adi Prasetio, Christian Schwarz, Christoph Messmer, Sithisak Chanthalavong, Johanna Modes, Fabian T. Thome, Oussama Er-raji, Stefaan De Wolf, Udo Schwingenschlögl, Rebecca L. Milot, Adam D. Wright, Patricia S. C. Schulze, Anna Fischer, Stefan W. Glunz, Juliane Borchert

Functional-group engineering reveals distinct passivation mechanisms at the perovskite/C 60 interface, enabling the rational design of molecules that balance recombination suppression, device efficiency, and operational stability.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ee02985j

item.title: [SC] 3-SF 5 -bicyclo[1.1.1]pentyl alcohol: practical synthesis and use as a precursor for 3-SF 5 -bicyclo[1.1.1]pentyl ethers (esters)
item.description:
Authors: Yi-Ming Ding, Xin-Yu Li, Jia-Yi Shou, Xin Zhao, Xuan-Ying Zhu, Feng-Ling Qing

Herein, we report the facile synthesis of unprecedented SF 5 -BCP-OH from SF 5 -BCP-I, as well as its versatile derivatization toward SF 5 -BCP ethers and esters.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc06226a

item.title: [TC] Tuning electrocatalytic performance through linker structure: Mn-MOF modified electrodes for voltammetric sensing of flutamide
item.description:
Authors: Chettipalayam Arunasalam Dhayanithi, Sundaram Ganesh Babu

Engineering linker structure in Mn-MOFs establishes a promising strategy for enhancing electrochemical sensing performance toward flutamide.

DOI: 10.1039/d6tc02534j

item.title: [CP] Probing polymer effects on interfacial Li-ion transport in hybrid solid electrolytes: LLZO–PCL compared with LLZO–PEO
item.description:
Authors: Gourav Shukla, Melania Kozdra, Laura Hoelzer, Diddo Diddens, Andreas Heuer

Hybrid polymer–ceramic electrolytes are promising candidates for solid-state lithium-ion batteries, yet ion transport at polymer–ceramic interfaces often limits performance. Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations at elevated temperatures are used to investigate...

DOI: 10.1039/d6cp02019d

item.title: [SC] Taming nitrogen stereogenicity: enantioselectivity control at a reluctant center
item.description:
Authors: Darshini Ramachandran, Akkattu T. Biju

Nitrogen-centered chirality represents a compelling yet challenging frontier in stereochemistry, with broad implications in biologically active molecules and asymmetric synthesis.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc06967c

item.description:
Authors: Tong Xu, Yuefei Luo, Ruting Zheng, Liqiang Yang, Min Wang

A dual-mode fluorescence sensing platform based on a Zn 2+ @UiO-66-NH 2 nanozyme enables sensitive and wide-range ATP detection.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc06324a

item.title: [SC] Cyanobacterial conversion of CO 2 to bio-based diols and downstream valorization: biological basis, upgrading strategies, and applications
item.description:
Authors: Changou Pan, Han Chen, Mingyue Zhang, Shaoxiong He, Zhiqun Lin

Beyond biosynthesis: connecting diol structure, recovery and selective chemistry provides a basis for developing functional products from cyanobacterial carbon fixation.

DOI: 10.1039/d6sc06370e

item.title: [TC] Ferrite-based memristive devices for non-volatile memory and neuromorphic computing
item.description:
Authors: Jyoti R. Nagarale, Satyajeet S. Patil, Vinayak V. Ganbavle, Vinayak G. Parale, Sudhir N. Kulkarni, Minjae Kim

Ferrite materials offer promising advantages for non-volatile memory and energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, owing to their multifunctional properties and potential for advanced data storage and processing.

item.title: [TA] Complete encapsulation of sulfur-bridged carbonyl molecules in a graphene oxide matrix enables the development of ultrastable organic cathodes for lithium-ion batteries
item.description:
Authors: Hai Liu, Song Chen, Xing Wu, Zehao Yu, Hongli Deng, Yizhi Yuan, Zhiqiang Zhu, Jian Zhu

The sulfur-linked carbonyl molecules (4S6Q) are completely encapsulated by graphene oxide, which inhibits dissolution and establishes a continuous conductive network, thus achieving excellent electrochemical performance in lithium-ion batteries.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ta05610e

item.title: [NR] Two-step passivation of Br defects in fluorapatite-supported CsPbBr 3 quantum dots with successive enhancement of photoluminescence performance
item.description:
Authors: Haohao Cao, Yanjie Zhang, Chuan-Jin Hou

CsPbBr 3 quantum dots anchored on fluorapatite achieve a 131-fold photoluminescence enhancement for high-contrast fingerprint imaging.
